card.headline: *ael* on top after six.
card.deck: Five wins from six for AEL Limassol. Omonia and Apollon are the only unbeaten sides.
card.footnote: Top eight of 14. Every club has played six games.

caption:
AEL Limassol lead the Cyprus League after six rounds: five wins from six and 15 points.

AEK Larnaca are second on 13. Omonia and Apollon Limassol have 12 each and are the only unbeaten sides in the league. Pafos FC are fifth on 11, and APOEL seventh on 8.

Who do you think finishes the year on top? 🇨🇾

Source: Cyprus Football Association
